title: Conducting Topography survey at North point Island Lighthouse station in North Bay, A & N islands.
summary: E-tender (percentage rate, two-cover) for conducting a topography survey at North Point Lighthouse station, North Bay, Andaman & Nicobar Islands (Sri Vijaya Puram / Port Blair Directorate).

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Sri Vijaya Puram (Port Blair)

sites.name: North Point Lighthouse station, North Bay

scope.item: Conducting Topography survey at North Point Island Lighthouse station

money.notes: EMD by Deposit at Call Receipt/FDR of any nationalised bank (Hindi: FDR or bank guarantee) in favour of Director of Lighthouses and Lightships, Sri Vijaya Puram, payable at Sri Vijaya Puram; valid 06 months from technical bid opening; originals with technical documents by post or in person; MSME/NSIC registration for similar work eligible for EMD exemption. Bid document free of cost in English table; Hindi table says 'shulk' (fee) without amount.

period.bid_validity: 180 days from date of opening of technical bid

eligibility: Eligible experienced civil contractors with successful completion of similar work of 'Conducting Topography survey in remote island of Andaman & Nicobar Island' with Government organisations and no adverse remarks
Detailed eligibility as per Section-III clause 3.1 (not included)
Near relatives posted as accountant or gazetted officer in DGLL/MoPSW bar participation (standard clause)
notes: Section I NIT only, Hindi (pp.1-3) and English (pp.4-6); no scope details or BOQ. Bid download/submission 02.12.2024 18:00 to 23.12.2024 15:00; technical bid opening 24.12.2024 15:00 subject to internet availability; original EMD by 23.12.2024 15:00.
